content: Lufutumuku lwa Yesu
Kunima dya sabata, muna suka-suka dya kilumbu kya theti kya phosa, Madiya mwisi Makatala yi Madiya wuna mukwawu benda tala mazyamu.
Kutala mafu manikani ngolu; mukuma wanzyo mosi wa Pfumu wákulumuka ku zilu, wisa bundumuna tadi amana kákala wazakala hana thandu ya dyawu.
Kifwani kyandi kyakala kedyamina hanga mitsyenzya, miledi myandi myákala mya phembi ya lawu.
Kikuma kya bwabuna, batsinzidi báyuka bweya bwa lawu. Bakala tekita amana bákituka hanga batu bafwa.
Mu kutambula ndinga, wanzyo wázimbula kwena bakhetu: «Lukalaku yi bweya, benu, mukuma nzayi ni Yesu wuna bákhoka ha kitakani lubati sanda;
keku haha, wufutumukini bwosu kázimbula. Alwisa, talenu homa hana kakadikini walandalala.
Alwenda tswatsu, zimbulenu kwena balonguki bandi: "Wufutumuki ha kati dya bafwa, amana tala wulutekididi kedi mu Ngadidi; kwakuna lwámumona." Tala, mana khádiki mawu mu kuluzimbwala.»
Amana bákatuka tswatsu ku mazyamu, bákala bazakama yi kitswi yi kyesi kya lawu amana bakhetu benda thinu kusamuna kwena balonguki bandi.
Kutala, Yesu wisi batundakana mu kuzimbula: «Kimboti kyenu!» Bawu bábwesuka, bámubumbakana muna malu mu kumufukamina.
Hanga Yesu wubazimbwadi: «Lukalaku yi bweya. Alwenda, samunenu kwena baphangi bama ni benda kuna Ngadidi: amana bangwána kwakuna.»
Meni dya batsinzidi
Tangwa bakala mu nzila, ndambu ya batshinzidi ba mazyamu, bisa mu mbanza, basamuni kwena bambuta ba banganga Nzambi moosu mosu mana máluta.
Buna bákutakana yi bambuta ba Bayuta, lukutakanu lwásalama: bábonga lukanu, amana bahana mbongu za lawu kwena baphumbulu
mu kuzimbula: «Zimbulenu: "Balonguki bandi bisi muyibaka muna phipha, bwosu tukadiki betu banimba."
Amana yuka ni kilolu mwisi Loma kayukabwa, betu twamúlembika, ndangu benu baluyangisaku.»
Batsinzidi bátambula mbongu, báhanga bwosu bábazimbwala. Amana ndinga yayi yámwangana kwena Bayuta tii yi kuna lelu dyadi.
Kituma kya Yesu kwena balonguki
Balonguki kumi yi mosi benda ku Ngadidi, kuna mongu wuna kábazimbwala Yesu ni benda
Tangwa bámumona, báfukama, kaasi bahika bákala yi keti-keti.
Yesu wábwesuka, wuzimbudi kwena bawu: «Kipfumu kyosu báphekakya muna zilu yi ha tsi.
Disongidila alwendenu, kitulenu batu ba makanda moosu balonguki bama; babotikenu mu khumbu ya Tata yi ya Mwana yi Kitembu Kyatoma;
balongenu mu kusadila moosu mana yilulongikidi. zayenubwoku, meni yenina yi benu bilumbu byosu tii yi kuna tsuka ya tsi.»
